cards.example_en: Under these circumstances, the match should be delayed.
cards.example_zh: 在这种情况下，比赛应该推迟。

cards.example_en: They kept training even though the weather was cold.
cards.example_zh: 即使天气寒冷，他们也一直在训练。

cards.example_en: Our community opened a small library in the old post office.
cards.example_zh: 我们社区在旧邮局里开了一间小图书馆。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：集中注意力
cards.example_en: Concentrate on the listening test and ignore the noise.
cards.example_zh: 做听力测试时要集中注意力，别管噪音。

cards.example_en: The content of the note on the fridge surprised the whole family.
cards.example_zh: 冰箱上那张便条的内容让全家人都吃了一惊。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：凉爽的；酷的
cards.example_en: The cool shade under the oak saved us from the heat.
cards.example_zh: 橡树下凉爽的树荫让我们躲开了酷热。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：全体人员
cards.example_en: The stage crew moved the piano during the interval.
cards.example_zh: 负责舞台的全体人员在中场休息时挪走了钢琴。

cards.example_en: The degree of noise in the canteen makes talking almost impossible.
cards.example_zh: 食堂里噪音的程度大到几乎没法说话。

cards.example_en: This small device beeps when the soil in the pot is too dry.
cards.example_zh: 花盆里的土太干时，这个小装置就会响。

cards.example_en: Download the city map before you leave home.
cards.example_zh: 出门之前先把城市地图下载好。

cards.example_en: The towels were dry after an hour in the hot sun.
cards.example_zh: 毛巾在烈日下晒了一个小时就干了。

cards.example_en: In the story the hero spares his enemy and ends the war.
cards.example_zh: 故事里，英雄放过敌人，战争就此结束。

cards.example_en: Songs and films enhance our spoken English after school.
cards.example_zh: 放学后，歌曲和电影能提高我们的英语口语。

cards.example_en: The museum has a room of toys from the era of black-and-white films.
cards.example_zh: 博物馆有一间展室，陈列黑白电影时代的玩具。

cards.example_en: Ripe apples fall from the old tree in autumn.
cards.example_zh: 秋天，熟了的苹果会从那棵老树上掉下来。
